verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v1: yā man yaghīthu bimushtaki wayuḥāfiẓu ʿabdā ʾatāhu ladayhi ʾamru bāhiẓu
verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v3: wabīsmika l-muʿṭī l-muʿīni wabāsiṭi wamuhaymini wakadhā s-sarīʿu llāḥiẓu
verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v4: wabīsmika l-bāqī ṣ-ṣabūri wamuqsiṭi wakadhā l-bawāqī l-ʾātī wahyā mawāʿiẓu
verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v5: rabbī ʾajirnī yā mujīru bifaḍlikum min kulli jaẓẓi ʿānidi wayufāẓiẓu
verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v6: thumma ṣ-ṣalatu kadhā s-salamu ʿalā n-nabī mā dhākiru min dhikrihi mutalaẓiẓu
verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v7: wabīʾālihi wabiṣaḥbihi ʾahli l-hudā qada kāna yarḍāhum ʾilahī l-ḥāfiẓu
verses.ya-man-yaghithu-c1-v2: ʾinnī t-tajaʾatu ilayka rabbi bāsiṭa biyudayyatī ʿindī lisānu lāfiẓu
